rule: highest out-of-fold validation precision among thresholds with recall >= target
rationale: Catches about 90% of labelled providers in validation for roughly a quarter of providers reviewed; recall stayed close to target in every fold. 95% would need about a third reviewed for 20 more catches.
disclosure: Proposed after the original held-out result (86 caught, 15 missed) was known, which motivated it. The threshold was chosen on out-of-fold validation predictions only. The frozen model, its original threshold and the original final evaluation are unchanged.
